# Associate Product Manager — TechCorp

## About the Role

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to join our Consumer Products team in New York City. You will work on products that serve millions of users and drive business growth.

## Responsibilities

- Own the product roadmap for our consumer mobile application
- Conduct user research and synthesize findings into actionable product improvements
- Write PRDs and user stories for new features and enhancements
- Run A/B tests to validate product hypotheses and measure impact
- Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, data science, and marketing teams
- Define and track KPIs and metrics to measure product success
- Manage stakeholder communications and alignment across the organization
- Drive go-to-market strategy for feature launches

## Requirements

- 0-2 years of experience in product management, consulting, or related field
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL and data analysis tools
- Familiarity with agile/scrum methodologies
- Experience with product tools such as Jira, Figma, or similar
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Passion for consumer technology and mobile products

## Nice to Have

- Experience in fintech or consumer finance
- Background in computer science or engineering
- Experience with growth and experimentation frameworks
- MBA or equivalent experience

## Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- Flexible PTO policy
- Remote-friendly with NYC office option
